items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: he had a little piano player named Bill Miller.

ctx.x: Were you playing with him? In the band at all, or just arranging?

I played a short period with him when -- he had a little piano player named Bill Miller. Excellent pianist. He's out in Hollywood now in one of the studios -- arranging and playing. Bill got sick for about a month and we were doing one-nighters, and then I played. But I was used primarily as an arranger, because a lot of times the band would be on the road, and I would stay home and write, but I'd make the arrangements, and a lot of times he'd be up in Boston, and that vicinity around, and I used to have to go up…
Did you have to copy your own arrangers -- arrangements? Or you said, they had a copyist.
